blocks.text: A Tampa CPA Explains Who is Eligible to Apply for Federal Tax-Exempt Status
While it would be nice if every company could claim tax-exempt status with the federal government, the fact of the matter is only a select number of organizations qualify as tax-exempt.
If you believe that your company or organization might qualify, you might wish to enlist the aid of a [Tampa CPA](http://reliancecpa.com) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, to make sure.
